# core.matrices.FrobeniusNorm { #optyx.core.matrices.FrobeniusNorm }

```python
core.matrices.FrobeniusNorm(matrix)
```

Frobenius norm of a matrix: ||A||_F = sqrt(sum of squared elements).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                   | Description                        | Default    |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|------------|
| matrix | [MatrixVariable](`optyx.core.matrices.MatrixVariable`) | MatrixVariable to compute norm of. | _required_ |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

>>> A = MatrixVariable("A", 2, 2)
>>> fn = FrobeniusNorm(A)
>>> fn.evaluate({"A[0,0]": 1, "A[0,1]": 2, "A[1,0]": 3, "A[1,1]": 4})
5.477...  # sqrt(1+4+9+16) = sqrt(30)
